$ETH A lot happened this week but also really nothing happened.

Most coins are right back where they started the week. Including ETH & $BTC who are both still in their range after taking liquidity below.

Easy to make the argument that we had a Clarity Act rejection + Rate hike and price didn't dump so bullish. But on the other hand, both those events were getting priced in for multiple days ahead so also not a big surprise the actual dump wasn't that bad.

For me the ranges still stand and they determine where this goes next, if we see a proper daily close/breakout outside of them of course.

ETH $2350-$2550
BTC $76K-$81K
